update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.40 - Tunable skill recovery-boost strength
Added ----- - Recovery Boost Strength (Skills settings, under Prioritize Recovery Skills for Stamina): the multiplier that nudges recovery skills up the auto-purchase ranking on Medium/Long builds is now a slider (1.0x-3.0x, default 1.5x) instead of a fixed value. 1.0x disables the boost entirely; higher values push recovery skills further up the list ahead of pure stat skills.
